_doc: Hand-curated classification of confirmed gaps that belong to SwiftUI (or to modules that `import SwiftUI` re-exports). Key = API string as printed by compare.py. cls: a visual, b inert, c platform-specific (tvOS/watchOS/macOS only; the 'then' field says whether it paints), d other framework. 'group' merges call-site variants into one table row.

.containerBackground(_:for:).note: paints the widget / tab-view / navigation container background; widgets and watchOS apps cannot render without it

.groupBoxStyle(_:).note: changes the look of GroupBox (card, plain, custom GroupBoxStyle)

.labeledContentStyle(_:).note: custom LabeledContentStyle: layout of LabeledContent rows

.menuIndicator(_:).note: shows/hides the chevron on Menu and Picker(.menu) labels

Table(...).note: multi-column table (macOS, iPadOS, iOS 17 collapses to first column); columns, headers, rows

Text(timerInterval:countsDown:).note: live countdown/up timer text; a static frame shows the formatted interval

.previewDisplayName(_:).note: preview-only metadata; layout and device are covered by the tool's --layout/--device flags

@Observable.note: macro: observation plumbing, no pixels; unknown attribute here, so every @Observable model fails to compile

@Entry.note: macro that declares a custom EnvironmentValues key (values still reach the view)

.menuOrder(_:).note: order of items inside an opened menu

ContextMenu(...).note: legacy contextMenu(_:) payload; only visible when the menu is open

MenuBarExtra(...).note: menu bar scene; not part of a window frame

ImageRenderer(...).note: renders a SwiftUI view to an image (share cards, exports); output is the view's own pixels

Menu(_:_:primaryAction:).note: Menu with a primary tap action; only visible when opened

.move(fromOffsets:toOffset:).note: collection helper used by onMove; no pixels

TabSection(_:_:).note: groups tabs in the iPad/macOS sidebar-adaptable tab bar (iOS 18)

tabViewStyle(_:) .verticalPage.note: full-screen vertical paging TabView on watch
